sanskrit_verse:
देशकालवयोद्रव्य प्रमाणाकृतिजातिषु
यत्र विप्रतिपत्तिः स्यात् साक्ष्यं तदसदुच्यते
transliteration:
deśakālavayodravya pramāṇākṛtijātiṣu
yatra vipratipattiḥ syāt sākṣyaṃ tad asad ucyate
sph_interpretive_translation: Where there is contradiction regarding place, time, age, property, measurement, form, or species, testimony in such matters is declared invalid.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from clarity and non-contradiction in perceptual and evidentiary domains
Causation must align with sequential manifestation without internal contradiction
Capacity-based responsibility requires unambiguous perception and reliable witness capacity
Restoration logic depends on truth-establishment through non-contradictory evidence
Consciousness alignment necessitates rejection of conflicting sensory or testimonial inputs
executable_legal_axioms: IF evidence contradicts across deśa, kāla, vaya, dravya, pramāṇa, ākṛti, jāti THEN invalidate testimony
IF witness report contains internal contradiction in observable categories THEN disallow as legal proof
IF sensory data conflicts in space-time-object continua THEN exclude from decision-making process
IF evidence lacks coherence in identity, form, or classification THEN treat as null datum
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any testimony showing discrepancy in location, chronology, subject attributes, or physical characteristics shall be excluded from consideration to preserve the integrity of dharma-adjudicated reality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that contradictory inputs disrupt sequential manifestation chains; therefore, misaligned testimonies are not punished but simply excluded to maintain ontological accuracy and prevent erroneous consequences.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Disqualification of contradictory testimony to restore epistemic clarity
Re-training of witnesses to enhance perceptual alignment with factual sequences
Reconstruction of event context to eliminate conflicting narratives
Realignment of judicial process around coherent, contradiction-free evidence streams
final_declaration: This law proceeds solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Contradictory testimony is not condemned but rendered ineffective. Dharma stands restored through alignment with pure consciousness. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
